attributes.name: Druva - Administrator Self Privilege Escalation
attributes.description: Detects a Druva administrator modifying their own account and changing their assigned administrator role. Self-directed role changes can indicate privilege escalation or misuse of administrative access.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects a Druva administrator modifying their own account and changing their assigned administrator role. Self-directed role changes can indicate privilege escalation or misuse of administrative access.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Administrator Updated"
    AND druva.change.fields == "adminRole"
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(TO_STRING(user.email), TO_STRING(user.id), TO_STRING(user.name))
| EVAL target_admin = COALESCE(TO_STRING(user.target.email), TO_STRING(user.target.name))
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL AND target_admin IS NOT NULL
    AND TO_LOWER(actor) == TO_LOWER(target_admin)
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
